cases.customer_question: Do yellow Design Details warnings on the Bluetooth SIG Review Page prevent successful submission when the registration does not include a Host layer?
question_variants: Can I submit with yellow caution icon?
cases.actual_issue: Review Page warnings were generated because the registration did not include a Host layer, creating concern about whether submission could proceed.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Not every warning on the Bluetooth SIG registration system indicates a failure. Some warnings simply inform the user about characteristics of the design. The important distinction is whether the warning blocks qualification or is only informational.
cases.consultant_answer: The yellow warning in Design Details was attributed to the absence of a Host layer in the registration structure. The consultant confirmed that the warning was informational and that submission could proceed successfully. The registrations were accepted and SDoCs were subsequently obtained.
cases.decision_logic: Review Page warnings must be evaluated based on their underlying meaning. Informational warnings that do not represent rule violations do not prevent declaration submission or registration completion.
cases.final_recommendation: Review the warning details rather than assuming all warnings are blocking errors. If the warning is only related to the absence of a Host layer and submission requirements are otherwise satisfied, proceed with submission.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Treating informational warnings as qualification failures can create unnecessary investigation, approval delays, and registration schedule impacts.
